title: NexGen Energy
summary: Canadian uranium developer with the high-grade Arrow deposit.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

NexGen Energy is developing the Arrow uranium deposit in Saskatchewan, one of the highest-grade undeveloped deposits in the world. It has secured permits and offtake interest but still needs construction capital. Uranium prices and project financing determine value.

Technology Exposure

  • Uranium development projects
  • High-grade uranium resources
  • Offtake agreements

What To Watch

  • Permitting and construction
  • Uranium prices
  • Project financing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
